name: Coffee Days
source:
There's this little coffee shop downtown. The coffee is great, but most of the clientele is there to stare at the buxom baristas!

On a dare, Jamie applies for a job.
She's certain that being thin, flat, and shy would disqualify her for the job...
Let alone fitting into the uniform! 

But she's about to be proven VERY wrong!

[From [url=https://spacerychen.itch.io/coffee-days]Itch.io[/url]]
